trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.right: By 1781 he had taught for years.
trap.why: Português usa o pretérito simples; em inglês “até 1781” com ação anterior pede past perfect.

fix.wrong: By 1781 he has taught for years.
fix.right: By 1781 he had taught for years.

fix.wrong: Having lay the foundation, he built.
fix.right: Having laid the foundation, he built.

fix.wrong: When he arrived, she already left.
fix.right: When he arrived, she had already left.

rewrite.prompt: Past perfect: “By 1781 he taught for years.”
rewrite.answer: By 1781 he had taught for years.

rewrite.prompt: Una com having: “He laid the foundation. Then he built.”
rewrite.answer: Having laid the foundation, he built.
